error.message: The loop through MIX13, MIX3, PUMP14, KREA4, SCDS5, HTXR6, MIX7, EXTR8, SPLIT9, HTXR19, HTXR10, HTXR18, SCDS15, SCDS11, SPLIT16, HTXR12, HTXR17 did not converge: at iteration 59, Column SCDS11: the rigorous column did not converge. Tried: Newton from the bubble-point start, steps of at most 20 K (8 iterations, 2598 ms: the residual stopped falling); continuation in the relative volatilities (stopped at 0 % of the way, after 1 steps, 1511 ms); Newton resumed from where the bubble-point start stopped, without the early stop (12 iterations in all, 965 ms: the residual stopped falling); continuation in the relative volatilities, the mean weighted by the liquid (stopped at 0 % of the way, after 1 steps, 1794 ms). Last residuals: material 114400 mol/s, equilibrium 0.6218, energy 571100000 W, specifications 77.12. By constant molar overflow the boil-up would be -140100 mol/s (the vapour above the feed, 27980, is less than the feed's own vapour, 168100): these specifications may have no column. Take a larger distillate or a larger reflux ratio (or a feed with less vapour). Two liquids are allowed on the stages (phases "VLL"); on the last iterate stages 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 held two liquids. Newton converges slowly where a stage's liquid sits at the edge of the two-liquid region. This does not show that the column has no solution: try other specifications (a larger reflux, another product flow), more stages, or another feed stage. (on an accelerated guess, broyden, 740000 % of the tear flows beyond the last pass's result; the last pass changed the tears by 3.93e-2. Check the specifications and the start values of the loop first; direct substitution, which never extrapolates, shows whether the guess was the cause). What usually helps: a purge or a smaller recycle fraction (a recycle with no way out keeps growing), a guess for the tear streams (S27, S7, S21, S15, S24) close to the answer, another tear stream, another convergence method, or more iterations.
